item.title: October 19, 2026: 7,500W Dual-Fuel Portable + Transfer Switch vs. 22kW Whole-Home Standby: 5-Year Outage TCO
item.description: Counter-Intuitive Takeaway: Installing a $320 compressor soft-start kit on a 3-ton central AC drops locked-rotor startup amps (LRA) from 88A to 29A—allowing a $1,100 portable dual-fuel generator and 50A interlock kit to run central air conditioning without spending $13,400 on a permanent standby unit.
